sources.captureStatus: The available image includes the whole column and fragment stack. The bottom margin was truncated.
sources.observation: The re-erected column is a stack of mismatched plain and fluted drums, with individually weathered edges over a low masonry base.
Flat rows of weathered ashlar and larger broken blocks lie at the excavated level. Flooded portions vary through the year.

limitations: OpenStreetMap fixes the standing column and the archaeological perimeter. Drum dimensions, low foundation runs and loose fragments are photo-based approximations.
The scene depicts the present stone remains. Water and vegetation follow the viewer’s site data. The nearby registered tombs are separate features.
